summary: Configure Grafana IRM: on-call schedule, escalation chain, Grafana Alerting integration, attach contact point to an alert rule, and test end to end.

needs.description: Grafana IRM app (grafana-irm-app) enabled on the stack with schedules, escalations, integrations and alert-groups pages.
At least one Grafana Cloud team with members assigned (users selectable in rotation 'add user' picker).
needs.evidence: Before you begin: At least one team defined with members

needs.description: At least one existing Grafana-managed alert rule (searchable in alert rule list) that can be edited to add the IRM contact point and then fire for the E2E test.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: At least one alert rule defined; connect-alert-rule search-query-input

reviewNotes: The e2e step needs the alert rule to fire (or uses IRM Send demo alert); rule should be one that fires reliably. Paths creates schedule/chain/integration named 'Production SRE' etc., so reruns may collide.
